request: Add a skill `block_card` (skills/block_card/skill.md and skills/block_card/tools.py) with two tools. `list_cards` returns the caller's cards. `block_card` takes one `card_id` and blocks exactly that card. Blocking is irreversible for the caller, so the skill's frontmatter must make the engine wait for the caller's confirmation before `block_card` runs, using a confirmation prompt defined in responses.yml; reading the list needs no confirmation. The instructions tell the agent to call `list_cards` first and never to block a card the caller has not confirmed. Tests the builder writes go under tests/.
excluded: Changing integrations.yml, any acceptance suite, or accept_lib.py. Those are separate tasks with a separate owner.
